sloka: तस्य चैवागमं रामः काव्यस्य श्रोतुमुत्सुकः ।पप्रच्छ तौ महातेजास्तावुभौ मुनिदारकौ ।। ७.९४.२२ ॥
transliteration: tasya caivāgamaṁ rāmaḥ kāvyasya śrotumutsukaḥ ।papraccha tau mahātejāstāvubhau munidārakau ।। 7.94.22 ॥

translations.english: The greatly effulgent Rama, eager to hear about the origin of that poem, questioned both those young ascetics.
